title: NASA Life Sciences Archive: Longitudinal Skeletal Mineral Tracking in Microgravity
description: Pre-, inflight, and post-flight dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) scans, quantitative computed tomography, and biochemical markers of bone resorption.
citation: NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA), Johnson Space Center

title: NASA Life Sciences Archive: Orthostatic Intolerance and Carotid Arterial Stiffness
description: Continuous ECG, ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, ultrasound carotid distensibility, and post-landing tilt test evaluations across 80+ spaceflights.
citation: NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA), Cardiovascular Laboratory

title: NASA Life Sciences Archive: Behavioral Health, Sleep Disruption, and Cognitive Fatigue
description: Actigraphy records, Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT) performance measures, and circadian biomarker shifts in astronauts aboard Skylab, Shuttle, and ISS.
citation: NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA), Behavioral Health and Performance
